title: Biswanath district
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Biswanath district, in north Assam on the north bank of the Brahmaputra, was formed in 2015 from Sonitpur district. Its headquarters is Biswanath Chariali town.

Places and life

Biswanath Ghat, on the Brahmaputra, is a historic river site with temples and a view over the river, and is a local pilgrimage and picnic spot. The district is agricultural, with tea gardens, rice and fisheries, and is home to Assamese, Mising, Bodo and other communities.
